'''Jaxom Back to the basics''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Jaxom]]
* '''Published:''' 11 May 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Theme/Fun
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Strategy:''' Back to the basics
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Back to the basics Jaxom LS 2002.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

A deck with no objective, defensive shields, or characters of ability greater than three.

== Strategy ==

A fun deck to play with.  Use squadron assignments to pull matching starfighter and pilots and have fun.  If your opponent is playing a ground based deck you will be surprised how well those pilots can preform on the ground.  Surface defense cannon is thrown in to give the piolts some back up.  If you have your own favorite starfighters/pilots, it is easy to add them in.  Have Fun!  ;)
